REFRESH_ROTATION: user_refresh_tokens row matching hash(sha256, presented) is selected FOR UPDATE before dicabut is read; then dicabut=1 and a new pair is issued. Replaying a spent token revokes EVERY live refresh token for that account and answers 401, because the schema has NO device_id column so no narrower correct action exists; per-device token revocation is recorded as impossible. All three rejection reasons share one client-facing string so the 401 is not an oracle. Access TTL reads config(sanctum.expiration)=1440 with a fallback so a future null cannot reopen the never-expire hole; refresh TTL 30 days; secret Str::random(80) stored only as SHA-256.
